resources.string: 1. ClipHistory needs Shizuku-Next, a free helper app, to see what you copy. Tap Download Shizuku-Next, then open the downloaded file and install it. If your phone asks, allow installing apps from your browser. Already have Shizuku? Uninstall it first: the two can’t be installed side by side.
2. Connect to Wi-Fi. Tap About phone below, then tap Build number 7 times. Enter your PIN if asked. This unlocks Developer options.
3. Tap Developer options below. Find Wireless debugging, turn it on and choose Always allow on this network.
4. Open Shizuku-Next and tap Start. The first time, it asks you to pair once: in Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code, then type the 6-digit code into Shizuku-Next’s notification.
6. Come back here, tap Connect and choose Allow. Copy any text to check: it appears at the top of your history. Pause recording before copying private text that another app might not mark sensitive.
